purpose: Separately distinguish a historical environmental correlation reconstructed with future years from a prediction model that a bird could in principle have learned using only prior seasons. This is a new source-only support diagnostic; never retroactively rewrite existing V7 primary q_j.
source: Original Kölzsch et al. 2015 JAE 30-year GDD-jerk spring onset time series 1982–2011 (not the separately reconstructed 1982–2013 ERA5 series), 16 stopover regions.

time_rule.environmental_training_rows: strict year < focal year, all years >= 1982, unique transition-year pair, source/destination same current year
time_rule.source_environment_at_focal_year_is_pote: source spring onset measured BEFORE focal bird's source departure; no such departure time is opened in the present source-only gate
time_rule.reference_source_full_window: Retrospective 1982–2013 correlation retains its source literature interpretation only, not decision-time information.
time_rule.separate_replication_note: PAYOFF-B ERA5 reconstruction 1982–2013 is not the Kölzsch original published 1982–2011 environment sample and requires a separately frozen sensitivity lane

candidate_measure.primary: Pearson correlation of earlier-site and later-site spring-onset DOY over all source years strictly prior to focal year, computed per independently fixed region transition
candidate_measure.secondary: fit destination environmental spring-onset DOY ~ intercept + same-year earlier-site spring-onset DOY on only previous years; output forward-year one-step environmental forecast error vs past destination-climatology mean. This does NOT imply focal animal observed source onset before departing.
candidate_measure.no_year_detrending_in_primary: Original V7 q uses raw correlation, so a detrended q is not quietly substituted
candidate_measure.cross_year_proxy_not_animal_q: Predictive connectivity / forward forecast support is a system property, not measured cognition, animal cue-use or payoff

prereg_validation: When adding a later original phenology source file, require each transition/year at most one row and original DOI/checksum
Verify environment record years 1982–2013 and target–source transition identities independently
No animal data or goose timing outcomes in source forecast CSV
A forward-year prediction cannot depend on a later year's environmental target and cannot train on focal year
Every forecast receives n historical pairs, signed Pearson r, fitted predicted destination onset and separately observed target onset for environmental-only score
Score against historical mean climatology and report only dependence-aware transition/year summaries; do not label source years as independent bird decisions
If source phenology time series are not publicly obtainable/identifiable, return SOURCE_PREDICTIVE_Q_NOT_ESTIMABLE and do not invent values.

original_published_support.supplementary: Kölzsch et al 2015 S2–S7 supply annual GDD-jerk spring-onset anomalies for source-target stopover-region pairs, while S1 supplies region reference mean and SD.
original_published_support.representational_invariance: Pearson correlation and ordinary-least-squares destination forecast squared errors relative to a past destination-mean benchmark are invariant when constant site-specific full-window means are subtracted from source/target onset dates. However the original fully normalized anomalies cannot by themselves reconstruct individual arrival minus absolute spring DOY.
